messages:
Aisha (docs): Heads-up  I'm triaging a couple of Optimize toolkit pages. Found a mismatch between the docs' quant profile names and the runtime aliases users see in logs. Opening a small PR to sync examples + add migration notes.
Aisha (docs): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1290 
Marcus (eng-ml): Nice. Which pages specifically? the quant-profiles table or the runtime config guide?
Aisha (docs): Both. quant-profiles page still lists 'q4f' as canonical; runtime uses 'q4_0' in the latest release. Also examples/python/batching.md has an old client constructor.
Priya (devex): Also saw the Node examples using legacy stream API. We should show the new async iterator pattern we recommend.
Sam (engineer): I can paste a compact Python example for recommended batching + cache. Minimal, ready to drop into docs.
Sam (engineer): ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
# recommended: adaptive batching + prefix cache for short interactive prompts
resp = client.generate('Summarize in bullets', model='redwood-2b', max_tokens=120, batch_policy='adaptive', cache_prefix_enabled=True)
print(resp.text)
```
Aisha (docs): Perfect. Can you also add a one-line explainer for batch_policy options: none, fixed-N, adaptive and default behavior?
Sam (engineer): Yep. Adding a short YAML snippet for quant profile canonical mapping so people know to map old runtime names: ```yaml
quant_profiles:
  - name: q4_0
    runtime_aliases: [q4f, q4_0]
    note: "4-bit fast kernels, favors latency for short seqs"
  - name: q8_1
    runtime_aliases: [q8_1]
    note: "8-bit profile for throughput-optimized workloads"
```
Marcus (eng-ml): Good. Please add migration guidance: if you see 'q4f' in prior configs, map to 'q4_0' in toolkit examples. That prevented a few support tickets.
Elena (support): Echoing Marcus: we had two tickets this week that were solved by that exact mapping. If you add a short troubleshooting FAQ line that says "model load reports 'q4f' -> use q4_0 docs alias" that would help.
docs-bot: PR 1290 opened by @aisha/docs: "optimize: sync quant aliases + snippet cleanup"  CI: docs-lint passed :white_check_mark:
Priya (devex): For Node/TS, propose using this streaming example: ```ts
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
for await (const chunk of client.stream.generate({ model: 'redwood-2b', input: 'Short summary please' })) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.text);
}
```
Priya (devex): I'll add a short comment about when to prefer cache_prefix_enabled (short-prefix reuse like chat starter prompts) vs full KV cache (session-level reuse).
Aisha (docs): Great — I'm going to: 1) replace constructor snippets, 2) add the YAML mapping + migration blurb, 3) update Node streaming example, and 4) append a tiny FAQ entry from Elena's note.
Marcus (eng-ml): Can I review the quant wording? I want to avoid wording that implies accuracy improvements for quant profiles (it's mostly memory/latency tradeoffs).
Sam (engineer): I'll draft the quant paragraph and ping you for sign-off.
Aisha (docs): Plan: target merge tomorrow EOD. @Sam, @Priya, @Marcus please +1 when ready. I'll cut a short changelog and notify support once merged.
Elena (support): Thanks  ping me on merge and I'll update the common troubleshooting KB with the alias mapping.
Priya (devex): One tiny nit: add a link to the SDK reference for generate/stream.generate in each snippet so folks can jump to the API surface.
Aisha (docs): Good call. I'll include inline links.
Sam (engineer): PR update pushed: added Python example, YAML mapping, and a short batch_policy table.
Aisha (docs): Reviewing now. If all good I'll merge after Marcus signs off. :rocket:
Marcus (eng-ml): Quick pass looks fine; request one wording tweak on the quant note. Added comment on the PR.
Aisha (docs): Addressed Marcus' tweak and merged. Changelog: "optimize: canonicalize quant profile names, refresh batching/caching snippets, add migration note".
docs-bot: PR 1290 merged by @aisha/docs  deploy: docs-website build succeeded :white_check_mark:
Elena (support): Updated KB with alias mapping and added link to the merged doc. Closing a couple old tickets. Thanks team!
Aisha (docs): Thanks everyone. I'll schedule a short follow-up to see if any further mismatches crop up in the next week.
